title: Adjunction for the ind-etale closed lift
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, and $\overline C$ an ind-etale $A/I$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra], regarded as an $A$-algebra through the quotient map. Let $H_A(\overline C)$ and $\epsilon_{\overline C}:H_A(\overline C)\to\overline C$ be the colimit algebra and its specified map of [def-exc-ind-etale-closed-lift]. For every ind-etale $A$-algebra $D$, put $ID=(\operatorname{im}(I\to D))D$. Then the rule $f\mapsto([d]\mapsto\epsilon_{\overline C}(f(d)))$ induces a bijection
$$
\operatorname{Hom}_A(D,H_A(\overline C))\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}_{A/I}(D/ID,\overline C),
$$
natural contravariantly in $D$ and covariantly in $\overline C$. Consequently $H_A$, with the maps of [def-exc-ind-etale-closed-lift], is right adjoint to reduction $D\mapsto D/ID$ between the categories of ind-etale algebras (morphisms are algebra homomorphisms).

proof.text: Reduction of D is ind-etale by the base-change clause of [lem-weil-pbc-ind-etale-stability], using the proved source-library RingHom.IndEtale.isStableUnderBaseChange directly rather than importing the bundled Sheaf theorem. Identify D/ID as the pushout of A -> D along A -> A/I using [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-quotient-base-change], implemented by the proved source-library CommRingCat.isPushout_quotient. For every A-algebra map q:D -> C, q kills ID because the A-algebra structure on C factors through A/I. Ideal.Quotient.lift therefore gives an A/I-algebra map D/ID -> C. Conversely precompose such a map with the quotient map; quotient representatives show these constructions are inverse. This constructs quotientHomEquiv without any lifting hypothesis on C.

proof.text: For any indexing object X of [def-exc-ind-etale-closed-lift], its underlying algebra is etale and hence finitely presented [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Use the factorization principle [lem-weil-pbc-finite-presentation-algebra-factors-filtered-colimit] in its categorical form: CommAlgCat.finitePresentation_le_isFinitelyPresentable and IsFinitelyPresentable.exists_hom_of_isColimit. Filteredness [lem-exc-closed-lift-filtered] supplies its filtered colimit hypothesis. A map f:X.alg -> H factors as the coprojection of Y after g:X.alg -> Y.alg. If epsilon f=X.toC, the retained-map identity gives Y.toC g=X.toC, so g is an indexing morphism X -> Y. The cocone relation identifies f with the coprojection at X. This is index_hom_unique and avoids passing to underlying rings or elements.

source.place: Tag 097P, lemma-lift-ind-etale, final two proof paragraphs; uniqueness expanded using finite presentability and colimit universal properties

proof.text: If D is etale over A, choose a polynomial quotient presentation e:P -> D using [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. For q:D -> C, form the indexing object (P,q e) of [def-exc-ind-etale-closed-lift]. Compose its coprojection with e inverse to obtain f:D -> H, and the retained-map identity gives epsilon f=q. If another f has this property, step 2 identifies f e with that same coprojection, so f equals the constructed lift after composition with e inverse. Thus etale_lift_unique proves existence and uniqueness; the proof itself proves independence of all presentation choices.

source.place: Tag 097P, lemma-lift-ind-etale, final two proof paragraphs; uniqueness expanded using finite presentability and colimit universal properties

proof.text: For ind-etale D choose its filtered colimit presentation P by etale algebras [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. For each stage choose the unique lift of q composed with its coprojection, using step 3; this choice is determined uniquely by that equation. Uniqueness makes these stage lifts compatible with every transition, so [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] descends their cocone to f:D -> H. Colimit hom-extensionality proves epsilon f=q. Any other lift agrees at every stage by step 3 and is equal by the same hom-extensionality. This is indEtale_lift_unique, so postcomposition with epsilon is bijective. Compose its Equiv.ofBijective with quotientHomEquiv of step 1 to construct closedHomEquiv. Its value on a quotient representative is definitionally epsilon(f(d)).

source.place: Tag 097P, lemma-lift-ind-etale, final two proof paragraphs; uniqueness expanded using finite presentability and colimit universal properties

proof.text: For phi:C -> C-prime, use iota_map and iota_toAlgHom from [def-exc-ind-etale-closed-lift] to prove epsilon-prime H(phi)=phi epsilon on every coprojection, hence globally by [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. The representative formula of step 4 gives contravariant naturality by substitution and covariant naturality by evaluating this equality at f(d). Finally H is ind-etale by [lem-exc-closed-lift-filtered] and [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. Apply step 4 uniqueness with source H to deduce preservation of identities and composition from the retained-map equality. These facts and step 1 establish every conjunct of exists_natural_homEquiv. No assertion about the counit being an isomorphism occurs in this theorem, so lem-exc-closed-lift-reduction is unnecessary.

lean.note: Adjunction expressed by its natural family of Hom equivalences, as in proof step 6 of the node. Naturality identities are evaluated on quotient representatives; surjectivity of the quotient maps makes these exactly the Hom-set naturality identities. No new definition is required. 2026-10-20 (U): retired Sheaf twin Sheaf.RingTheory.ProEtale.ClosedLiftAdjunction; points at its upstream twin.
